basis: A row belongs to the period that contains its known_from (the first session it was public), not its trade_date.

final_holdout.label: contaminated for ideas tested before 2026-10-27
final_holdout.unlock_rule: explicit Unlock('final_holdout', reason); the unlock is written to the trial log before any row is returned

forward_holdout.label: clean: no experiment had read it when this file was frozen
forward_holdout.unlock_rule: explicit Unlock('forward_holdout', reason, preregistration) where preregistration is a spec file committed to git and unmodified; only the final pre-registered test may unlock it

backward_2015_2021.note: Lies inside development. Already used once to judge the frozen VRP condor (trial vrp_condor_pooled_holdout); a check of regime robustness, not an unseen test.

seen_2025_plus.source: trial_log.sqlite (data_start/data_end per idea) and the output files' own date ranges, measured 2026-10-27

experiments.note: trial log has no dates; range from store/chronos/*.parquet

experiments.idea: GARCH / GJR / EGARCH volatility model choice
experiments.note: not a trial-log idea; range from store/vol_forecasts

experiments.idea: regime HMM design (3 states, p > 0.7 for 2 days)
experiments.note: not a trial-log idea; range from store/regime
descriptive research page, not a trial; scripts/market_map.py

No VRP condor or results-day fly trade was open across the day.
